rows.text:
*A scrawled up piece of paper, covered in messy handwriting.*

This is an Aetherium Wars Secret Guild Guide left by Pitch-Dark Hook the Great. Just follow what is written, and one day you will become a master of Aetherium Wars!


• Pick Aether Spirits with a type advantage against the opponent when fighting.

• Praise your Aether Spirit often.

• Seek out opponents at your level.

• When you see an attack coming, remember to loudly warn your Aether Spirit to dodge.

• Decorate your terminal beautifully, it's best to use Geomorrow Geomarrow ore.

• If you come across Hook the Great of The Moles, remember to shout: "Pitch-Dark Hook the Great."

• Collect 151 Aether Spirits.

• Do one hundred set sit-ups a day.


If none of this works, just recite the name "Pitch-Dark Hook the Great" ten times and offer up one pack of snow-white popping candy every Wednos Wednas Wedes Wednesday to The Moles.
